meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: 把任务拆成一条条极细的步骤写进计划清单,并先把目标登记到 ulw-loop 状态里;每一步都要有可观察的证据,测试跑通不算完成。上下文丢失后先重读目标与账本再继续。
howto.when: 当你要求 ulw-loop / ulw 这类目标循环,或需要带检查点、有证据的长时间执行时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把这件事拆成一步步来,每步都要有证据
say.note: 会先按 define-goal 登记目标

say.text: ulw-loop status --json 看下现在到哪了
say.note: 读取当前会话的进度状态

say.text: 上下文丢了,用 ulw-loop 从账本继续
say.note: 先重读目标与账本再恢复

howto.what_en: Decomposes work into ultra-granular steps in a live plan checklist, registers goals in ulw-loop CLI state, and binds each success criterion to observable evidence (terminal, HTTP, browser). Tests alone never prove done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ulw-loop, ulw, or checkpointed, evidence-led long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop to break this into checkpointed steps, each with evidence.
say_en.note: Registers the goal first, then builds the plan

say_en.text: Context was lost; resume ulw-loop from the ledger.
